sectors.name: Renewables & Climate-Tech
themes: Indonesia's coal phase-down and captive industrial solar mandates create structural demand for domestic EPC and IPP players like BRPT and TPIA, independent of short-term index moves.
Global utility re-rating (AWK, EIX, ES) reflects durable regulatory tailwinds for water and electric grid modernization, which Indonesia's PLN must mirror to attract foreign capital.
Carbon pricing and JETP funding commitments (US$20B) provide multi-year visibility for climate-tech supply chains, favoring integrated players like BATR in biomass co-firing.
sectors.ai: Indonesia's renewables sector shows divergence: domestic laggards (-1.11%) mask selective strength in coal-to-clean transition plays like TPIA (+2.87%) and BRPT (+1.43%), while US utilities (AWK +2.59%, EIX +1.46%) signal global capital rotation into regulated green infrastructure. Watch for policy catalysts from Indonesia's upcoming RUPTL revision and carbon tax implementation to unlock value in local names.

sectors.ai: Indonesia consumer/FMCG underperformed US peers today, but select movers like AGAR (+24.75%) and ECII (+13.82%) signal targeted momentum in niche staples and coffee.
